entities.summary: Neha Kirpal is an Indian social entrepreneur. She is known for her work in the arts and mental health. She founded the India Art Fair in 2008, and she is a co-founder of Amaha, a mental health organization. She was awarded the Nari Shakti Puraskar, an annual award by the Ministry of Women and Child Development of the Government of India to individual women or institutions for work towards women empowerment.
